integrity: The two-household ordering equivalence and the three-household range-product criterion are proved symbolically. The positive-integer cutoff through total income eleven is exhaustively enumerated with exact rational Gini values and integer products; the packaged verifier replays all cases.
scientific_limitations: The sharp integer cutoff is for three equally weighted households with strictly positive integer incomes, common total income, and Atkinson inequality aversion epsilon=1. The result does not extend unchanged to zero incomes, other Atkinson parameters, unequal household weights, or comparisons at different means.
title: Three-household Gini–Atkinson reversal starts at total income eleven
